item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that the last finished tick and the last finished sweep pass each publish what they served from cache, extended incrementally and recomputed in full with the bytes read; reckon/crew/station.py:462 and :1337 open file_memo.counting() around each pass and reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:529-544 publishes last_sweep beside last_tick, so the deliverable is present.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, nine commits, baseline_suite df8fba8b (completed, 0 failures) and after_suite f18c1375fb (completed, 0 failures), the widened arms carry identical two failure ids on both sides, and negative_control_log names repair2-negative-control2.log with EXIT=1; it records no ruff result although the done_when asks for one.

justifications.fit: the code follows the surrounding idiom of reckon/crew/station.py:1140 and the ContextVar scope of reckon/file_memo.py:53, and introduces no plan, ticket or version label in a name or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/station.py:1337-1341 wraps the tick and :462-467 wraps the sweep pass so each report carries memo_counts, and reckon/file_memo.py:520 plus reckon/_backends.py:3862 record recomputed answers with their byte lengths.
justifications.reuse: no per-pass counting owner existed; file_memo.py:113 extends the module's existing ContextVar-scoped region idiom and _backends.py:4724 extends the pre-existing _PARSED_STREAM_BYTES total rather than adding a second counter.
justifications.scope_discipline: every one of the nine paths in df8fba8b..0958895bcc is a declared write path, and the two out-of-fence cohort fixes were made in reckon/crew/station.py rather than by editing peer test files.
